sources: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/arp/conditions (Clear Creek Ranger District Campground Status table)

hookups.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/arp/recreation/guanella-pass-campground ('There are not electric/water/sewer site hook-ups at this campground.') + recreation.gov notice ('There are not electric, water, or sewer RV hook-ups at this campground'), read 2026-10-27

values.note: Two loops split by the county road and South Clear Creek; the FS page counts 18 sites, 11 suited to RVs and 7 to tents (the status table and recreation.gov list 17). Parking spurs 20-45 ft, all back-in, gravel roads; large RVs are not recommended on the byway.

sites.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/arp/recreation/guanella-pass-campground ('There are 18 sites ... Elevan are suitable for RV camping and seven are more suitable for tents. Large RVs are not recommended on the byway.'; 'The parking length ranges from 20 to 45 feet.') + recreation.gov per-site catalog (17 sites, 10 RV-capable all Back-In, max lengths 20-45) + https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/arp/conditions (Guanella Pass: Sites 17), read 2026-10-27

facilities.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/232306 ('This facility provides hand pumps with potable water, vault toilets and trash dumpsters.') + FS page (Restrooms: 'Vault toilet(s)'; 'Potable water is available at this site.'), read 2026-10-27

values.note: 2026 operating season June 5 - Sept 13; the FS page now shows the site closed for the season.

season.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/arp/conditions (Clear Creek Ranger District Campground Status: Guanella Pass, Operating Season 'June 5 - Sept 13') + FS campground page banner 'Site Closed', read 2026-10-27

values.note: Reservations close 4 days before arrival; limited first-come sites. Weekend minimum 2 nights, holiday weekends 3; up to 14 nights in a rolling 60 days. Sites not occupied within 26 hours go first-come. One vehicle included, extras $8 a night.

booking.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/232306 (rules reservationCutOff 4 'day(s) prior to arrival', minWeekendStay 2, minHolidayWeekendStay 3, maxStay 14 'Rolling 60 Days'; notices 'Limited first-come, first-served sites are available', 'All campsites must be occupied within 26 hours', 'EXTRA VEHICLE FEES ... $8.00 per vehicle per night'), read 2026-10-27

values.note: $26 a single site; extra vehicle $8 a night.

fees.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/arp/recreation/guanella-pass-campground ('Single Site: $26 per night') + https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/arp/conditions (Fee $26) + recreation.gov rates 2026 and 2027 Peak Season RV/STANDARD NONELECTRIC 26, read 2026-10-27

note: Clear Creek RD, Arapaho-Roosevelt NF, on the Guanella Pass Scenic Byway about 7 miles south of Georgetown at 10,900 ft, beside South Clear Creek; mostly open sites with some tent sites under spruce. --Claude
summary: FS page, ARP status table and recreation.gov: confirmed 17 sites (FS page says 18), no hookups, $26 (2026/2027), recreation.gov. The stored 45-ft max now has an agency source (FS page: parking spurs 20 to 45 ft; catalog's longest 45), all back-in. Added season June 5 - Sept 13, vault toilets and hand-pump water, booking rules (4-day cutoff, 2-night weekend / 3-night holiday minimum, 14 in 60 days, limited FCFS). Pin 190 m from the catalog centroid. Note trimmed of field facts.
flags: Length sources differ: the FS campground page says parking spurs 'range from 20 to 45 feet' (catalog max 45), but the ARP Clear Creek RD status table lists Max Spur 35' for Guanella Pass. Recorded 45; EKKO fits either way. The FS page and recreation.gov also say 'Large RVs are not recommended on the byway' (Guanella Pass Rd).

Missing phone: recreation.gov lists 801-226-3564 for the facility (its 'Contact Info' text gives (530) 529-0578, apparently another concessionaire's number); FS Supervisor's Office 970-295-6600. No district phone was found on the FS pages.
